model.name: schema.testsImplOnly
model.description: The schema + lint enforce that the tests[] attachment source is Implementation.tests[] only: the field is deleted from the always-empty Loaders and a lint forbids a non-empty tests[] on any non-Impl class (2-bite). One-time migrate of the 21 Method.tests to Impl precedes the MethodLoader delete + the scoreboard read-switch.
